sloka: ततो रामः परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवम् प्रिय दर्शनम् ।प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणानुगतम् वचः ॥४-१२-१२॥
transliteration: tato rāmaḥ pariṣvajya sugrīvam priya darśanam ।pratyuvāca mahāprājño lakṣmaṇānugatam vacaḥ ॥4-12-12॥

translations.english: Then wise Rama embraced handsome Sugriva and replied in these words which were agreeable to Lakshmana:
